proposal.text: Make gravity follow the pitch of my microphone.

job.message: Microphone input and pitch detection are unavailable. Gravity can be modified, but no supported field exposes your microphone’s pitch.

observation: First real unsupported attempt; host reason visible, but model omitted adaptation and UI offered no adaptation action. Base game and reused-law fallback remained available. Retained before follow-up fix; not an original-intent success.
